articles.summary: We’ve introduced a new mixed labeling type that supports labeling spans within a line while also categorizing entire lines separately. This allows you to configure questions for each line and still perform regular span labeling. Perfect for use cases that require dual-level granularity like transcripts, contracts, or forms.
articles.title: A New Way to Label Text: Span + Line Labeling

articles.summary: Datasaur’s enhanced Search extension streamlines data labeling by enabling instant, precise searches with advanced filtering, logic building, and bulk actions, boosting both speed and accuracy across large datasets. Designed for non-technical users, it empowers reviewers and labelers to efficiently manage complex annotation tasks.
articles.title: Efficient Labeling and Review: The Search Extension
